query.description: Extra query params passed through to the endpoint.

companyAuth.description: Use the agency (company) token instead of a location token.

tools.name: ghl_catalog
tools.description: Search the FULL GoHighLevel v2 endpoint catalog (576 operations across 41 groups) for anything not covered by a typed tool. Each match returns method + path + required params + scopes + auth — hand {method, path} straight to ghl_raw (set companyAuth:true when auth=='company'). Filter by free-text query, group, and/or method.

group.description: resource group, e.g. contacts | invoices | forms | workflows | payments
